notes.title: December 30 Update
notes.content:
MAIN MENU

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/055d256f81da0ff4a776c391ec820db47e6a57ab.jpg

The main menu now features a darker theme and has become more distinct. We aimed for the significant update Night to be its precursor.

SPEED BOOST

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/638a891707cee4d6264fe3f984597d21275951be.jpg

Now, as you eliminate enemies, your character will gain a certain amount of speed boost. This acceleration can affect all aspects of your character and consists of three stages. The percentages are outlined below.

-1: 5% Speed Boost
-2: 10% Speed Boost
-3: 15-20% Speed Boost

SCAN

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/ed23d41d734e8cc86d5ff9da7ba2c2bdef07d86e.jpg

The effect and timing of the scanning feature have been adjusted.

Stun

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/fbe21b1dbbb344852f583ea0545205f71597d6a5.jpg

Now, beneath the enemies' health bars, there are Stun bars. When these bars are filled, enemies freeze for a few seconds and cannot move or attack.

Until the next update, goodbye! I am working hard to bring the "Alaca" game to its best version. I would be very grateful for your support on this journey.

notes.title: Scanning Skill Update
notes.content:
With the skill that we can scan enemies with scanning, it is now easier to distinguish enemies. We can also see the locations of the Teleportation stones and instantly see how far away they are.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/c2068097a00ac30cea6c8a961a1cf47fd194af2b.jpg

notes.title: 18 December Update Notes
notes.content: A persistent skill has now been added where we can scan for enemies around. With the alt key, we can scan for enemies and demise areas from enemies faster.

notes.title: November 20 update notes
notes.content:
Teleport

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/b2b8d92d7b95e311bf1c1e78805a3ab26107281f.png

Now, if you clear all the islands in a Tier region, a teleport will open that allows you to return to the Base.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/03b5e5839be7f164f2e23e7702adeb6700ef52bf.png

Additionally, the teleport will remain open for you to return.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/601577afeffc84f4312572e6e6997530235fbccc.png

You'll receive a small notification when you clear one island.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/50ca0c97b1862d003444fb91ade17879a98240d7.png

When you clear the entire tier, you'll receive a large notification.

notes.title: November 11 Update Notes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
-Fixed a bug where enemies were taking damage after death.
-Fixed an issue where enemies were sometimes getting stuck in obstacles.
-Adjusted and fixed some damage systems.
-Fixed the acceleration conflict between the cursed weapon and perk.
-Fixed an issue where the collision of XP tokens was staying open for 1 second.

Optimization Improvements
-Optimized effects in some areas.
-Improved and optimized the footprints under the monuments.
-Optimized the shader for grass.
-Reorganized the level of detail (LOD) for trees.

notes.title: November 8th Update Notes
notes.content:
Now, you can check your equipped weapon's level progression and other attributes using the "Tab" key. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/7ab064becfa3d2369c9e050eef521dae6bc081a9.jpg

 You can also see these progressions and the weapon's level on weapon loot. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/d80e56e00e10eb014c0540b89bc9e1bc637f8303.jpg


 Furthermore, you will be able to view these progressions at the blacksmith. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/fa70af30a1ea79e2334821f5a64e91ea1e814ddb.jpg


 Now, notifications indicating the difficulty level of the areas you enter will be displayed. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/c81fe810161479e8ec9ac15d11d56e22f96521dc.jpg


 New Loot Appearance 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/b5726753e2301d542170ccb0aa3aa1b9159cd2b2.jpg

In addition to these features, various bug fixes have been applied. We hope you enjoy an enhanced gaming experience with this update. Happy gaming!

notes.title: November 7th Patch Notes (2)
notes.content:
-Ice waves no longer spawn inside us.
-Fixed an issue where destroying a monument of a biome would make enemies disappear in other ----islands of the same biome.
-Now, when we roll with the space key, we can pass through enemies.
-Main menu language setting has been fixed.
-Confirmation setting for returning to the main menu has been fixed.
-Fixed the issue of climbing rocks in certain areas.
-The attack duration of the axed orc has been reduced by 0.2 seconds.
-Depending on the pot upgrade, you will start the game with that many pots.
-The usage speed of the Eagle Skill has been increased by 30%. (You will be able to use it faster)."

notes.title: November 7th Patch Notes
notes.content:
November 7th Patch Notes

-Increased the range of the long sword.
-Accelerated the attack speed of the long sword.
-Fixed the area of effect for the short sword.
-Added a pop-up when mana runs out.
-Increased the speed of eating rocks.
-Reduced the waiting time for rocks from the ground by 1 second.
-Fixed the speed bug for enemies.
-Increased our walking speed with the weapon holstered.
-Fall animation has been fixed
-Fixed the issue of button inputs getting messed up when using skills with the equipment button.

notes.title: Live on Steam with Alaca.
notes.content:
Alaca
[previewyoutube=2Lj_d_6L4Z4;full][/previewyoutube]

Alaca Steam'de erken erişim olarak yayınlandı. Alaca combines roguelike and top-down perspective game mechanics to take you on a journey to a fantastic world, providing a unique gaming experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/75f7bd4830991264e1c281283ca1d6699791a9f9.png

If you prefer, you can progress step by step, or you can confront the boss. Thanks to the dynamic structure of the map, all decisions are up to you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708454/2e393cd41fb2642e0219b2f776ee1f8dc51f72bb.png

Our Early Access Roadmap
Our goal is to release Alaca in the FULL VERSION as quickly as possible. A release schedule for updates will be announced in the near future.

You can join our Discord group to provide feedback and support us during the early access period."
